purpose: Compare HDR repair percentages across the five treatments; show every independent biological repeat and mean ± sample SD. One quantity is decoded by treatment position; no inferential comparison is adopted.
mechanism: neutral single-quantity bars with raw repeats/SD
expected_benefit: All five open bars and three dots per treatment remain readable; neutral position decoding avoids an unnecessary five-color key.
observed_tradeoff: The small 72 × 48 mm canvas needs oblique two-line treatment labels. The full labels fit, but label area is a substantial fraction of the canvas.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
